comment: Mirror of platform/services/catalog-pricing/db/seeds.rb (11 VM line-items) PLUS the
client's real 2026 price-list items added for the sellable storefront.
Response shape = FROZEN docs/08-delivery/contracts/order-payment-api-v1.md
GET /api/v1/catalog_items entries. display_price is presentation-only.
catalog_item_id values are deterministic stand-ins for seeded row ids.
PRICES: every item below carries the client's real 2026 figure. The ONE item -> client
document -> figure map is lib/catalog-sources.ts, derived from lib/villa-pricing.ts (the
single transcription home) and enforced by tests/fixture-contract/catalog-sources.test.ts
(a published entry without a recorded source fails, naming the item) plus
tests/fixture-contract/commerce.test.ts (each figure equals the sheet's). Sources:
· sheet A = '2026 price FV website A' (= 'PRICE LIST FOR 2026 II') — the five a-la-carte
fees, the embalming day table (3-9 days + '>9 +1500/day'), and the 'For package'
casket catalogue (24 models, REGULAR SRP);
· sheet III = 'PRICE LIST FOR 2026 III' — chapel use rates (common 1500/day, private
3500/day; senior columns are the sheet's 3–9 day totals, not cart lines);
· 'COMPLETE MEMORIAL PACKAGE.jpg' — the plan payment schedules.
This DIVERGES from the upstream platform seed, which still carries placeholder prices
(documented limitation upstream). The SKUs are unchanged; the client's figures win here.
SKU map: PKG-BASIC/STANDARD/PREMIUM = the plan's monthly amortization (Bronze 1 /
Silver 1 / Gold — the tier mapping is PROVISIONAL, see lib/catalogue-skus.ts);
SRV-EMBALM-D = sheet A '>9 +1500/day'; SRV-EMBALM-3D…9D = the 3–9 day table;
SRV-RETRIEVAL / SRV-DELIVERY / SRV-VIEWING / SRV-ORD-COFFIN / SRV-INTERMENT = the five
a-la-carte fees; CHP-COMMON-DAY / CHP-PRIVATE-DAY = sheet III's chapel per-day rates;
CSK-<MODEL> = one entry per model on sheet A's 'For package' table (regular SRP).
The plan is sold at its monthly amortization because the package page's buy card is
monthly-first; the other terms select a prefilled request instead.
WITHDRAWN (2026-09-18, captain's 'only the client's data' pass): the four upstream line
items no 2026 client sheet prices were REMOVED rather than published at an invented
figure — SRV-LIGHTS (600.00), ADD-COFFIN-LIZO-SR (850.00), ADD-FLOWERS (250.00),
ADD-URN (180.00). None is priced by any client document: the 2025 service contract
names a Lights line and Lizo JR/SR with a blank amount column, and the 2026 sheets price
neither. The upstream platform seed still carries them; the reasons, their placeholder
amounts and the office-arranged public state are recorded in
lib/catalog-sources.ts (WITHDRAWN_CATALOG_ITEMS), and the contract test fails if one
returns without a client source. The ids 107/109/110/111 are retired with them: a stale
gitignored .data/ catalogue journal that edited one now fails the read (unknown item)
instead of resurrecting it — delete .data/commerce-catalog.json if your demo edited one.
The demo orders/billing fixtures no longer sell them either (commerce/orders.json).
